raw_response: {"diagnosis":"silver_transactions ignores the currency column, so 90 EUR rows are summed as if they were USD. raw_fx_rates has exactly one rate per currency (EUR 1.25, USD 1.0, dated before the data window), so the amounts can be converted to USD in silver and all gold tables follow.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.8,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(ROUND(CAST(t.amount AS DECIMAL(18,6)) * CAST(f.rate_to_usd AS DECIMAL(18,6)), 2) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t JOIN raw_fx_rates f ON f.currency = t.currency WHERE t.status = 'POSTED'"}}
